howto: 打開 Claude App → 進「語言學習」專案 → 開語音模式 → 貼上（或唸出）下面的開場。講滿 3 分鐘，講錯不要停。結束後把文字紀錄貼給 Dobby，他只修 3 個最值得改的地方。
opener: Dobby, today's speaking topic is: {topic}. Please let me talk for about three minutes first. Ask me one follow-up question if I stop. Don't correct me until I finish.

q: 你在哪家公司、什麼部門、做什麼？
一週裡最常做的三件事？
你最喜歡工作裡的哪一部分？
p: A big part of my job is …

q: 你們做哪一類產品？賣給誰？
一條線材／連接器由哪些部分組成？

p: First thing in the morning, I …
Before I leave, I make sure …

q: 回高雄的話通常怎麼過？
你們能不能做到？有什麼限制？
問題是什麼、在哪裡發現的？
你們怎麼處理、怎麼防止再發生？
p: To prevent it from happening again, we …

q: 報到時櫃檯會問什麼、你怎麼答？
轉機時間很短，你會怎麼問地勤？
p: I'd like to check in for the flight to …
Could I have an aisle seat?
How much is the excess baggage fee?
Which gate is my connecting flight?

q: 客戶問什麼時候能出貨？
p: The lead time is about … weeks.
If we can't make it, I'll let you know in advance.

q: 等人到齊的時候可以聊什麼？
對方從國外來，怎麼問旅途？
p: Is this your first time in Taiwan?

q: 目前做到哪裡？完成多少？
p: The goal of this project is …
The next step is …; one risk is …

q: 你會推薦外國同事吃什麼？

p: I'm afraid … has been delayed by …

q: 現在的做法有什麼問題？
p: The current process has a problem: …
It would take about … to set up.

q: 房間有問題（冷氣、Wi-Fi、噪音）怎麼講？
p: Could I get a different room?
Could I have a receipt for the company?

q: 對方說做不到，你怎麼回？
p: Is there any way to speed this up?
Could you do better on the price?
If we order more, can you …?

q: 結果是什麼？通過還是失敗？

p: Please wear the safety shoes / ESD strap.
I'm sorry, I can't share that information.

q: 怎麼叫服務生、怎麼買單？
p: I'm allergic to … / I don't eat …
Could we have the check, please?
Could you make it less spicy?

q: 先怎麼回應（不急著辯解）？
p: Let me look into this and get back to you by …
We'll make sure it doesn't happen again.
Option A is …, while option B is …
A is cheaper, but B is more reliable.

q: 怎麼問去車站／會場怎麼走？
p: Excuse me, how do I get to …?
Which platform is the train to …?
I think I took the wrong train.
One thing I'm proud of is …
My role is to make sure …
